channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: A pregnant asylum seeker is free, but says ICE detention upended her life
item.description: Shortly after The Nevada Independent published an article in late January about her detention, Emine was released from ICE detention. Her conversation with The Indy provides a snapshot of what immigration detention is like for pregnant individuals.

item.title: Solicitante de asilo embarazada ya está en libertad; dice que detención de ICE ha afectado su vida
item.description: Además de no haber recibido atención prenatal en la cárcel de Henderson, Emine Ş dice que los meses en detención le han causado daños económicos y emocionales.

item.title: Nevada nowhere near meeting 2030 greenhouse gas emission goal
item.description: Nevada fell well short of its greenhouse gas emission-cutting goals in 2025, and it’s poised to be much further behind when the bar raises again in 2030.

item.title: ‘Rogue cowboys:’ Sportbooks fight prediction markets even though their Super Bowl cut is likely small
item.description: Nationwide, sportsbooks are expected to see between $1.6B and and $1.7B in bets on the Seahawks and Patriots, but Nevada won’t match its 2024 record.

item.title: Legisladores de Nevada señalan problemas de seguridad con túneles Vegas Loop de Boring Co.
item.description: En medio de acusaciones de favoritismo, personal de la oficina del Gobernador Joe Lombardo y de Boring Co. perdieron la oportunidad de atender varios problemas ambientales y violaciones de procesos.

item.title: Mark Amodei will retire at the end of his term
item.description: The congressman, who has served for a decade and a half, is the only Republican in Nevada’s delegation.

item.title: Congresista Republicano por Nevada Mark Amodei anuncia su retiro al final de su mandato
item.description: El legislador es el único Republicano en la delegación que representa a Nevada en el Congreso y ha estado en el cargo por más de una década.

item.title: Judge criticizes Nevada DMV’s response about communications with ICE
item.description: Judge Kristin Luis order the agency to provide all records unredacted for her review and sworn declarations about its record-searching process and use of the encrypted messaging app Signal.

item.title: Jueza critica respuesta del DMV de Nevada acerca de comunicaciones con ICE
item.description: La jueza Kristin Luis ordena al DMV que proporcione todos los registros sin redactar para su revisión y declaraciones juradas sobre su proceso de búsqueda de registros y el uso de la aplicación de mensajería encriptada Signal.

item.title: Mark Amodei explains his surprise decision to retire from Congress this year
item.description: Amodei said concerns about Republicans losing the House in 2026 did not shape his decision. He is the latest of nearly three dozen House members to hang up their hats ahead of the midterms.
